record_source: All records are newly authored, template-expanded benchmark prompts; none were copied verbatim from existing project datasets.
known_limitations: This is a policy-derived benchmark, not an independent held-out benchmark.
Template expansion may underrepresent spontaneous user language despite varied phrasings.
The current evaluator has no per-record LLM answer-assertion schema; LLM semantic correctness still requires human review or future assertions.
Sensitive-data and transfer records test routing expectations, not authorization enforcement or real transaction execution.
